title: agent-quick-menu plugin menu file
description: A plugin's .claude-plugin/quick-menu.json: quick-launch commands and settings shown in the quick menu.

version.description: Schema version. An unknown version is skipped with a notice.

title.description: Section heading; default the plugin name.

command.description: Command name as / takes it, without the slash.

settings.description: userConfig field names of this plugin, in display order. Omitted: all rows. []: none.
